comments.why: Why treating vectors as matrices causes trouble in languages.
comments.text: > Purist test The short answer is. Yes, but if your PL treats it that way you will wind up in trouble [0]. The long answer is: [VIDEO] (but seriously take the time to watch this, it's fantastic). [0] Separately C- and often C-derived languages/frameworks like numpy also treat them as 1xN matrices, but that's a nearly tabs-vs-spaces level religious war, with actual consequences. I think a lot of people got confused when translating andrew ng's early octave-based ML coursera course (Nx1) to python (1xN), and also in the back and forth between math ML papers which use Nx1 and python.
